title: Accept the exact Ask-traceability scope repair
problem: PR #826 proved the existing completed Action was too narrow for #591. Its implementation must not be merged while the governed Action falsely claims that traceability work is complete.
desired_effect: Accept only the reviewed Plan amendment that keeps close-ask-traceability-and-cli-portability-gaps open and replaces its #591 criterion with the required capture_id propagation, ask-show lookup, dashboard receipt link, and objective coverage; retain the delivered #716 bridge requirement.

does: Validate the exact Ask SHA-256, pinned semantic envelope, primary pmark/arcadia main checkout, synchronized origin/main, inherited reviewed base, unchanged Project pointer, Plan activation and responsibility
Use shared arcadia-plan-amendment-v1 to preview the exact settlement flags at click time, validate structured effects, then apply that same fresh fingerprint and retain durable receipts
Push only the resulting fast-forward main settlement after Arcadia confirms the exact accepted disposition
never_does: Change the queue, current Action, active Plan, any other Action or Project, or any Action status beyond Arcadia's exact reviewed Plan amendment
Touch PR #826, merge or deploy, activate production, press a Grant, start or restart services, use credentials, or settle any other proposal or Decision

success.effect: The reviewed Action remains open with truthful #591 scope and its deterministic #716 bridge requirement; Arcadia's settlement is committed and published on main with a durable receipt.
success.next: Start a fresh isolated implementation worktree from the published main revision, reuse only #826's implementation work, and complete the expanded acceptance before opening a replacement PR.

failure.effect: No unvalidated or broadened governance change is made. If settlement succeeded before push failed, the receipt remains durable and the same request may replay only if every pinned precondition still matches.
failure.next: Read the reason, changed field, and recovery instruction shown on /runs. Restore the named precondition and retry this exact action. PUBLICATION_FAILED recovers the existing commit without a second settlement; never change the queue, pointer, or proposal.
